constant_and_branch_audit: message_area_right_end reuses activation constants and cites MessageArrow.getRightEndInternal.

anti_overfit_audit.architecture: The claimed normalized model is incomplete. SequenceLifeLines and sequence_lifecycle_layout coexist with independent mutable activation_depth, act_depth, ActivationTracker/open_activations, and render_activation replays. The held-out failures differ by consumer, which is the expected signature of those competing histories.

findings: The historical regression evidence is strong: 37/37 designated strict perturbations and 16/16 review6 cases pass.
Fresh held-out evidence is 8/17, so the implementation is not accepted.

Java LifeLine.addSegmentVariation does not sort close before open. It preserves arrival order and rejects an opposite variation at the same ordinate. Rust sequence_lifelines sorts retained variations and closing_keeps_depth patches only one ordering, producing a fresh reverse-order bar failure.
Matching self-message lifecycle geometry remains wrong: the fresh accepted activate/deactivate case produces a bar 6px too short.

Active-source cross behavior does not generalize across nesting and spatial direction: both mirrored fresh cases fail by one activation half-width, and one also changes participant spacing and canvas width.
Left-note missing-space preparation is not modeled: a valid long left note draws at negative x and leaves the canvas 94px too narrow.
Grouped side-note and TO_RIGHT geometry do not share Java's resolved element model. One grouped left note is forced 142px away from Java; grouped TO_RIGHT arrows end 7px early.
Nested InGroupable propagation remains inconsistent: one fresh case makes the frame/divider 10px too wide while its exo arrow remains 7px too short.
The implementation contains no mechanical fixture echo, but its multiple consumer-specific state replays and coordinate floor override are model-level overfitting risks.
mechanism_assessment: The commit repairs every known review6 counterexample but does not implement the account's single normalized lifecycle and horizontal-element model. The fresh failures and direct Java-source contradiction disprove the claimed invariant.
required_follow_up: Model LifeLine variation acceptance in source arrival order, including Java's same-Y opposite-type rejection, and make bar construction query that accepted timeline.
Remove activation_depth, act_depth, open_activations, and render_activation as independent histories or make them derived views of one accepted LifeLine model.

Register notes, nested group lists, exo arrows, and dividers as actual horizontal elements, then run one prepareMissingSpace/envelope solve; remove group_note_left_floor_by_event coordinate replacement.
Recheck active-source area endpoints and spacing constraints at nested depth in both spatial directions.
